historical_run.model: Meshy 7.1, according to the historical README; ai_model omitted.
historical_run.note: Credits and model attribution are historical README observations, not newly verified API responses. The exact generation timestamp and task response were not retained in this record. Archived tutorial observations (not a new run or inspection): Historical README reported armchair generation in 3 min 30 s–3 min 48 s, 168,196–249,108 triangles, 29.0–32.6 MB GLBs, and estimated heights of 0.80–0.85 m. Dimensions were not physical measurements.
